# aether_node_pool (Data Source)

One node pool of a cluster, looked up by `id` or by `name`. A pool that does not exist is an error, never an empty result. A pool that is still being deleted can match by name (its `status` is then `deleting`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the cluster the pool belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Node pool UUID to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Pool name to look up. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set. A pool that is still being deleted (`status = "deleting"`) holds its name until the platform removes it, so it can match.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `current_nodes` (Number) Nodes the platform currently observes.
- `desired_nodes` (Number) Requested node count of a fixed pool.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk per node in GB.
- `drain_timeout_seconds` (Number) Per-node drain timeout in seconds; null when the pool tracks the platform default.
- `first_ready_at` (String) Time the pool first had a ready node (RFC 3339); null until then.
- `max_memory_gb` (Number) Autoscaling budget: maximum total memory in GB; `0` means no budget.
- `max_nodes` (Number) Stored upper node bound. Autoscaling is decided by the four budget attributes, not by this value.
- `max_vcpus` (Number) Autoscaling budget: maximum total vCPUs; `0` means no budget.
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory per node in GB.
- `min_memory_gb` (Number) Autoscaling budget: minimum total memory in GB; `0` means no budget.
- `min_nodes` (Number) Stored lower node bound. Autoscaling is decided by the four budget attributes, not by this value.
- `min_vcpus` (Number) Autoscaling budget: minimum total vCPUs; `0` means no budget.
- `node_labels` (Map of String) Kubernetes labels applied to every node; empty when none.
- `node_taints` (Attributes List) Kubernetes taints applied to every node; empty when none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_taints))
- `scale_down_delay_seconds` (Number) Autoscaling: how long a node must be unneeded before removal; null for the platform default.
- `scale_down_utilization_percent` (Number) Autoscaling: utilization below which a node counts as unneeded; null for the platform default.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: `provisioning`, `running`, `scaling`, `scaling-down`, `degraded` or `deleting`.
- `status_message` (String) Explanation accompanying a `degraded` status.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).
- `vcpus` (Number) vCPUs per node.

<a id="nestedatt--node_taints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_taints`

Read-Only:

- `effect` (String) `NoSchedule`, `PreferNoSchedule` or `NoExecute`.
- `key` (String) Taint key.
- `value` (String) Taint value (`""` when none).
